title: processes.step.completed.v1
description: A flow node completed. durationMs runs from the token entering the node to its completion. Handed to the host publisher in the transaction of the state change it reports. Additive changes only within v1 (DESIGN section 6.4).

eventId.description: Stable id of this event, 26 characters; consumers de-duplicate by it

occurredAt.description: The engine clock time of the change, ISO 8601 UTC

tenantId.description: The tenant, from the authenticated context; consumers must filter by it

correlationId.description: The request's X-Correlation-Id; for work a job starts, the id the job carries; otherwise the event id

causationId.description: The id of the command (Idempotency-Key) or job that caused the change, or null

businessKey.description: Present when the instance has a business key; the only personal data an event may carry (TR-SEC-05)

attemptId.description: The activity execution id, or null
